missing_or_gap_capabilities.capability: Equal-input-budget robustness comparison (AuthGuard-Seq vs Flat CNN under flooding)
missing_or_gap_capabilities.status: MISSING and HIGH PRIORITY. Confirmed code-level finding: under F200/M3+F200, AuthGuard-Seq is scored with NO max_chunks cap (unbounded), while Flat CNN stays capped at 2048 tokens via uniform-stride downsampling, same as its clean-data path. Median F200 appended-donor bytes ~5170 atop a median ~2585-byte executable region plausibly pushes many flooded contracts well past 2048 tokens. The reported F200 AUPRC gap (0.920 AuthGuard-Seq vs 0.535 Flat CNN) is therefore potentially confounded by input-budget mismatch, not purely architecture -- undisclosed in FINAL_RESULTS_MANIFEST.md/ROBUSTNESS_OPERATIONAL_FINAL_SUMMARY.md/ROBUSTNESS_EVALUATION_REPORT.md. Fix is cheap: call encode_bytecode(variant, chunk_size=256, max_chunks=8) in create_variants() for a budget-matched inference-only variant, no retraining needed.
